items.title: Awesome Cpp
items.content_text:
### Data visualization

*   [mathplot (⭐14)](https://github.com/sebsjames/mathplot) - C++ header-only graphing and data visualization with modern OpenGL. \[Apache-2.0] [website](https://sebsjames.github.io/mathplot/)

### Math

*   [sebsjames/maths (⭐4)](https://github.com/sebsjames/maths) - A templated C++20 math library which emphasizes convenience and pleasure for the client programmer (used in [mathplot (⭐14)](https://github.com/sebsjames/mathplot)).  \[Apache2] [website](https://sebsjames.github.io/maths/)
